questions.stem: Which quadrilateral has two pairs of parallel sides and all sides equal in length?
questions.explanation: A rhombus has two pairs of parallel sides and all four sides are equal in length.

questions.stem: Which property do all parallelograms share?

options.text: Opposite sides are equal and parallel

questions.explanation: In every parallelogram, opposite sides are equal in length and parallel.

options.text: Are equal in length and bisect each other

questions.explanation: A rectangle's diagonals are equal in length and bisect each other, but they are not perpendicular (unless it is also a square).

questions.stem: A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. It is a:
questions.explanation: A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides.

questions.stem: Which quadrilateral has diagonals that bisect each other at right angles AND are equal in length?
questions.explanation: Only a square has diagonals that are both equal in length and bisect each other at right angles.

questions.stem: A kite has two pairs of adjacent equal sides. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
questions.explanation: A kite has exactly one line of symmetry, along the diagonal that connects the vertices between the pairs of equal sides.

questions.stem: Which statement about a rhombus is FALSE?

options.text: Diagonals bisect each other at right angles

questions.explanation: A rhombus does NOT have equal diagonals (unless it is a square). Its diagonals bisect each other at right angles but are generally different lengths.
